object.description: This object maintains an instance of a (key/value pairs) of the service. The information is extracted from DNS TXT records {{bibref|RFC1035}} of the discovered service. When multiple instances of the {{object}} table have the same value for the {{param|Key}} parameter, the implementation is CPE specific.
